selected_evidence.summary: Valkey is enabled and active; AOF with every-second fsync uses `/var/lib/valkey`. Startup logs show AOF replay, and the final persisted value is readable.

selected_evidence.requirement: Dedicated inventory identity and root-only generated credential
selected_evidence.summary: The generated 64-character hexadecimal credential is stored as `0600 root:root`; the ACL stores only its SHA-256 hash. Authenticated inventory access returns PONG while unauthenticated access returns NOAUTH.

Healthy baseline boot ID was `d4784d1b-162e-4faa-b581-f6427617d23c`; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID became `7da2e6e2-1ac7-49bf-9a9f-823b75422cde`. Service, listener, authentication, AOF recovery, credential permissions, and stored data all recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 077
credential=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
credential_hash=$(printf '%s' "$credential" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
tmp_env=$(mktemp /etc/redis-inventory.env.XXXXXX)
printf 'REDIS_USERNAME=inventory\nREDIS_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]]] "$credential" "$NODE_IP" > "$tmp_env"
chown root:root "$tmp_env"
chmod 600 "$tmp_env"
mv -f "$tmp_env" /etc/redis-inventory.env
tmp_acl=$(mktemp /etc/valkey/users.acl.XXXXXX)
printf 'user default off\nuser inventory on #%s ~inventory:* +@all -@admin -@dangerous\n' "$credential_hash" > "$tmp_acl"
chown valkey:root "$tmp_acl"
chmod 600 "$tmp_acl"
mv -f "$tmp_acl" /etc/valkey/users.acl
sed -i -e "s/^bind .*/bind 127.0.0.1 $NODE_IP/" -e 's/^appendonly no$/appendonly yes/' -e 's|^dir .*$|dir /var/lib/valkey|' /etc/valkey/valkey.conf
if grep -q '^aclfile ' /etc/valkey/valkey.conf; then
  sed -i 's|^aclfile .*|aclfile /etc/valkey/users.acl|' /etc/valkey/valkey.conf
else
  printf '\naclfile /etc/valkey/users.acl\n' >> /etc/valkey/valkey.conf
fi
restorecon -v /etc/redis-inventory.env /etc/valkey/users.acl /etc/valkey/valkey.conf /var/lib/valkey 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'configuration-written\n'
stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /etc/redis-inventory.env /etc/valkey/users.acl

commands.command:
set -eu
. /etc/redis-inventory.env
[ "$REDIS_USERNAME" = inventory ]
case "$REDIS_PASSWORD" in
  ''|*[!0-9a-f]*) printf 'credential-format: invalid\n'; exit 1 ;;
  *) : ;;
esac
[ "${#REDIS_PASSWORD}" -eq 64 ]
printf 'identity-name: %s\n' "$REDIS_USERNAME"
printf 'credential-format: generated-hex-%s-chars\n' "${#REDIS_PASSWORD}"
printf 'credential-file-mode: '
stat -c '%a %U:%G' /etc/redis-inventory.env
printf 'acl-secret-storage: [REDACTED]]]plaintext-present\n'; exit 1; else printf 'sha256-only\n'; fi
export REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD"
printf 'identity-authentication: '
valkey-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" --user "$REDIS_USERNAME" PING
printf 'identity-data-access: '
valkey-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" --user "$REDIS_USERNAME" GET inventory:restart-proof
commands.stdout:
identity-name: inventory
credential-format: generated-hex-64-chars
credential-file-mode: 600 root:root
acl-secret-storage: [REDACTED]]]]
identity-authentication: PONG
identity-data-access: node1-persistent-value

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'vm.overcommit_memory = 1\n' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-valkey.conf
chown root:root /etc/sysctl.d/99-valkey.conf
chmod 644 /etc/sysctl.d/99-valkey.conf
restorecon /etc/sysctl.d/99-valkey.conf 2>/dev/null || true
sysctl -w vm.overcommit_memory=1
sysctl vm.overcommit_memory
commands.stdout:
vm.overcommit_memory = 1
vm.overcommit_memory = 1

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'final-boot-id: '
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'final-service: '
systemctl is-enabled valkey.service | tr '\n' ' '
systemctl is-active valkey.service
printf 'final-persistence-config: '
grep -E '^appendonly yes$|^appendfsync everysec$|^dir /var/lib/valkey$' /etc/valkey/valkey.conf | tr '\n' ';'
printf '\nfinal-kernel-setting: '
sysctl -n vm.overcommit_memory
printf 'final-credential-permissions: '
stat -c '%a %U:%G' /etc/redis-inventory.env
. /etc/redis-inventory.env
export REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD"
printf 'final-inventory-ping: '
valkey-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" --user "$REDIS_USERNAME" PING
printf 'final-persisted-value: '
valkey-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" --user "$REDIS_USERNAME" GET inventory:restart-proof
unset REDISCLI_AUTH
printf 'final-unauthenticated-check: '
valkey-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p 6379 PING 2>&1
commands.stdout:
final-boot-id: 7da2e6e2-1ac7-49bf-9a9f-823b75422cde
final-service: enabled active
final-persistence-config: dir /var/lib/valkey;appendonly yes;appendfsync everysec;
final-kernel-setting: 1
final-credential-permissions: 600 root:root
final-inventory-ping: PONG
final-persisted-value: node1-persistent-value
final-unauthenticated-check: NOAUTH Authentication required.
